_note: Copy to private/config/sources.json. getro_boards: investor job boards hosted on Getro (public sitemap + job pages, D50-D51, D57). a16z_boards: a16z-style portfolio boards (public sitemap + company pages, D61). Boards that need a sign-in are not supported. serper: search-engine discovery (D52, D66); each title is searched on each readable job-board site in any of the places, once every every_days; one search page = one credit; needs SERPER_API_KEY in private/.env.
